job_title:
Data Scientist, Tempus Discover
Data Scientist, Tempus Discover with verification
points: \item Developed a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving document-level QA reliability and data extraction accuracy, applicable for processing complex clinical and genomic data.
\item Built hybrid retrieval workflows combining dense embeddings and BM25 search to enhance structured and unstructured data retrieval, enabling efficient identification of patient cohorts.

\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess data quality, accuracy, and relevance across hundreds of examples, ensuring production-ready reliability in high-stakes clinical environments.
\item Introduced batched query extraction to reduce LLM calls by 80%, enabling efficient, scalable analytical workflows suitable for multimodal clinical and genomic datasets.
\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection systems for administrative and QA pipelines, ensuring data integrity and reliability for downstream biomarker development projects.
\item Containerized and deployed AI/ML solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring reproducible and scalable pipelines aligned with Tempus’ multi-modal data platform.
\item Collaborated cross-functionally with Data Science, Research, and Engineering teams to standardize data documentation, communicate technical insights, and support academic research partners.
